dialogues.speaker: Thianges
dialogues.text: What's wrong? What do you think!? Just look at that endless queue, not to mention the mountain of forms to fill out once you get through it! It's even bigger than a stack of application forms from the Fontaine Research Institute!

dialogues.speaker: Thianges
dialogues.text: Every step has to be checked over and over again. It's like these people are terrified of registering people or goods that shouldn't be allowed in or something...
